question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

An instrument for detecting an earthquake
solution:
The correct answer is '**Seismograph**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• An instrument for detecting an earthquake is called a '**Seismograph**'
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **Seismograph**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Electrograph** is a curve or plot automatically traced by the action of an electric device.
 
• **Spectrograph** is an apparatus for photographing or otherwise recording spectra.
 
• **Magnetograph** is an instrument for recording measurements of magnetic forces.
